bullets.content: [general] One factor per solve, hard rule: before each solve list every difference from the previous mesh call (h, box extent/size, group size/radius) old→new; if more than one, split into separate solves. REPEATED MISTAKE (solve 3 changed 3-4 factors; compare unattributable). Execute the promised experiment in solve 1 unchanged.

[general] Use all 4 solves (a2 g5 left one unused). Plan S1 control, S2 one-factor tweak, S3 best remaining hotspot idea, S4 combination. Call compare(a,b) on one-factor pairs; before submit compare(best, runner-up) and note where >50% of diff sits; view(error, iso) after EVERY solve.

[general] Before every solve compare free mesh() node count with the control. If change is under ~1% (8125→8162) the refinement is swallowed: skip the solve, change size >=1.4x or pick another factor (a wasted S2).

[general] A deterministic mesh re-solved gives identical energy (0.033756 J twice). Never spend S1 on a stored recipe: record its stored energy and nodes as the control and make S1 the assigned change.
[general] One factor per solve: S4 mixed saddle size and upper-box size, -0.26% energy unattributable (REPEATED). To fund refinement by coarsening elsewhere, test the coarsening alone first.
[general] Before reasoning about score, write each solve's nodes, DOFs (=3x nodes), c=DOFs/automesher DOFs and SE in one line (a wrong +1% nodes vs 8.5% savings claim).
[general] A playbook 'Next:' suggestion will likely be run by a peer too (a2 and a5 made the identical 6350-node mesh). Pick a tweak only you are assigned, or the solve ties and teaches nothing.
[general] Do not re-run a mesh whose result is already known (solve 2 duplicated a6's h 0.0042 baseline). Reuse old numbers and spend the solve on an untested size or target.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] After each solve call view(kind=error, view=iso) and read the 5 hotspots; they pointed at f20/f10/f16/f19 rims, not edges 39/8, and should direct the next refinement.
[general] Announce any plan change from your first message in one line with the numbers that drove it (e.g. nodes 8866 at h 0.0055 vs 7746 at h 0.0095), else the teacher cannot credit the promise.

[general] After each solve: view(error, iso), list hotspot local h, compare(previous, newest). Before submit compare(best, runner-up) of two different candidates; judge energy per DOF vs 0.027 x dN/N break-even.

[general] Read each hotspot's local h after every solve. If it stays above the requested group size (0.0043 vs 0.003), face-group refinement is not reaching the volume. Switch to a {box} or {point} refinement at the hotspot with radius >=0.004.

[general] Thin walls (2.5 mm) with h larger than the wall give under one quadratic tet through thickness: bending converges slowly (~h^1.1), error spread over hundreds of hotspots. Uniform refinement is roughly score-neutral; refine locally where walls meet.
[general] Node count can drop after adding a refinement (5080→4878) because the mesher is non-monotone. Judge a mesh by element size near target groups and by energy, not by node count.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Quadratic tets worked: quality 0.25, no folded cells. Check folded_cells=0 and quality.min>0.1 on every mesh.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Reference-free estimate read ~2-3 points low (est ~14% vs true ~16.5% at h0.0042). Add ~3 points before testing against the 15.93% target.

[general] Submit by estimated score ((0.3186/(1.22·eta))/2)^2/(DOFs/6057), not fineness or energy alone: it gave class-best base 0.224 at 16.8k vs 0.223 at 23.2k. Bet on hidden-point bonus only when base scores are within ~5%.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Check reactions vs applied load on one solve. Peers saw a z-reaction sign flip between meshes from curved-face pressure integration. Confirm equilibrium within a few % before trusting compare().
[general] Strain energy alone does not rank solves (0.0329 at 5.6k nodes vs 0.0332 at 6.4k gave near-identical score). Use compare() on hotspot regions and estimated score.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Setup verified correct repeatedly: 3d, E 210e9, nu 0.3, fixed f2, pressure f23 4e6, f16 2.1e6. Check-point errors P0,P2,P3 <1.4%. Reuse verbatim; error was mesh-driven.

[general] [bc7] Coarse h 0.0095 with boxes earned +0.1 diversity bonus. a4 showed h 0.012-0.015 is inert (8009-8014 nodes vs 8125), so coarser is a dead end. Keep h>=0.006 so recipe stays distinct from peers at 0.0045-0.005.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Assigned: a1's recipe (h 0.0095 + saddle boxes [0.010,-0.012,0.019,0.017,0.012,0.030] and x-mirror 0.0026 r0.002, 8591 nodes, 0.033815 J), change ONLY h to 0.006. Free-mesh h 0.006 and 0.007 first, record nodes. Break-even dU/U>=0.027 dN/N (+10% nodes needs >=0.03391 J); if nodes >+15% solve 0.007.

[abc_00000003_bc7] h governs only outside boxes: bosses f15/f17, caps, band z 0.056-0.060 above upper box (19.6% ring error at h 0.0045, graded f2→h). After the h 0.006 solve check if ring cells' share and mean h (<0.0045) drop; if not, h isn't the ring lever.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Saddle boxes [0.010,-0.012,0.019,0.017,0.012,0.030] and x-mirror at 0.0026 r0.002 on the a2 base are the best recipe: +5.7% nodes, +0.18% energy, field 16.0%, base 0.232. Keep in every bc7 mesh; target hotspots #2/#3/#5/#6.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Never coarsen upper box [-0.02,-0.017,0.036,0.02,0.017,0.056] above 0.0048: upper 0.0055 costs ~0.4% energy (saddles 0.0028+upper 0.0055 gave 0.033668 vs control 0.033756; a1 saddles 0.0026+upper 0.0048 gave 0.033815).
[abc_00000003_bc7] f2 size 0.0030 vs 0.0033 (r0.005) is inert (+37 nodes, 0.033757 vs 0.033756 J; f2 touching h ~0.0046). Never solve f2 size again; ring band is set by grading to global h.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Lower box 0.0040 instead of 0.0046 fails break-even at h 0.0095 (+4.3% nodes for +0.08% energy; a1 +5.2% for +0.05%). Keep 0.0046 unless global h changes; P3 ~10% low but points don't bind.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Upper box 0.0048 left four cells at z~0.056 with 200-240% local error (~20% error energy). Test only this box at 0.0040 r0.003 (~+5-8% DOFs, field ~15.5%). Also separately a tighter clamp box z 0.050-0.0575 at 0.0036.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Junction rim hotspots #2-#6 (f9/f10/f12/f13, z 0.021-0.025) at 14-15% error, h 0.0037-0.0039. Try junction box 0.0030 r0.003 as separate solve; accept ~+10% DOFs only if field error drops >=1 pt. Box size is a3's variant.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Small boxes with radius 0.002 and size ~0.0028 do nothing at h 0.0095 (swallowed, nodes 8123); don't repeat. Use radius >=0.003 and check nodes change by >=100 before solving.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp ring z≈0.056 by f20 held 19.6% error at h 0.0045 with f2 0.0033. Single tweak: f2 back to 0.003 r0.005 (expect +150-300 nodes, +0.1-0.2% energy). Accept if ≥0.05% energy per +1% nodes; you are 0.4 pt from the 15.9% target (crossing g=2 changes scoring).
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Lower box 0.0046 left 9% low (cell z≈0.005, -y) and P3 -10.2%; a3 at h~0.0043 got P3 -2.2%. If field is under target, test lower box 0.0042 as separate solve; not first.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Never relax several sizes at once to save DOFs (0.003→0.0033/0.0046→0.0048/0.0044→0.0046 saved 1500 nodes but left f2 ring coarse). Relax only boxes whose cells hold <2% error each.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Never add edge 40 (0.0022 r0.003 at h 0.0095: +3.7% nodes, +0.01% energy); ring hotspots sit ~1 mm from f20 at z≈0.0557.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Edges 8/39 at 0.0026 r0.003 on h 0.0095: teacher saw +0.26% energy for +4.9% nodes (break-even, base 0.234→0.237); self saw them swallowed (0.03376 vs 0.03367). Contested: test dropping them and spending DOFs in boxes.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] f15/f17 small end faces at h 0.0076 have near-zero stress, dark error map: leave coarse to save DOFs.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Setup verified repeatedly; reuse verbatim: 3d, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3, fixed f12, pressure 2.1e6 on f7. P0 within 0.4%.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Copy a5: wall 0.004, edge 22 0.0025 r0.005, root 0.0022, pocket 0.0034 at h 0.008 gave 9.24% at 16128 DOFs, best base 0.713. Coarse wall 0.004 is safe when root box ≤0.0022.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Keep root box tight (x 0.016-0.03, y -0.014..0.012, z -0.0081..-0.004); widening in x or y added ~2000 nodes for no energy gain. Never relax it above 0.0022: at 0.0026 field error rose 8.46%→8.86%, base 0.741→0.713.
